_about: Karl Otfried Müller (1797-1840), A History of the Literature of Ancient Greece, translated by George Cornewall Lewis and continued after the author's death by John William Donaldson (1811-1861): A History of the Literature of Ancient Greece, continued by J. W. Donaldson, vol. I (London: Longmans, 1858); A History of the Literature of Ancient Greece, continued by J. W. Donaldson, vol. II (London: Longmans, 1858); A History of the Literature of Ancient Greece, continued by J. W. Donaldson, vol. III (London: Longmans, 1858), raw IA OCR. Classical scholarship (lane B pivot of 2026-10-10 from translations to public-domain English scholarship on the classics). No uids minted. Also The History and Antiquities of the Doric Race, tr. Henry Tufnell (died 1854) and George Cornewall Lewis, second edition, revised, 2 vols. (John Murray, 1839), raw IA OCR. Added 2026-10-23: clean Gutenberg witnesses (slugs ending -pg) beside the raw OCR of the same works.  Round ea adds Introduction to a Scientific System of Mythology (tr. Leitch, 1844).
